user.title: Connect your inverter
user.description: Connect directly to the factory E-Linter network adapter. Stop other local inverter pollers before continuing.

data_description.host: IP address of the factory Ethernet/Wi-Fi adapter, without http:// or a port.

data_description.modbus_address: Leave at 1 unless the inverter unit address was changed.

reconfigure.title: Change inverter connection
reconfigure.description: The new address must reach the same inverter serial number. Your entities and history are preserved.

data_description.modbus_address: Leave at 1 unless the inverter unit address was changed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the adapter. Check its IP and allow Home Assistant to reach TCP port 80.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address without a URL scheme, port, or path.
error.unsupported_model: This inverter model is not supported.
error.invalid_address: Enter a whole-number Modbus address between 1 and 247.
error.invalid_response: The adapter returned invalid or incompatible register data. Confirm the model and pause other local pollers.
error.wrong_inverter: This address belongs to a different inverter. Reconfigure must use the original inverter.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This adapter or inverter is already configured. Use Reconfigure to change its IP address.

init.title: Hardware and energy options

data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between shared sensor updates (10–300). Default: 15 seconds.
data_description.battery_installed: Enable only after connecting a battery. Otherwise battery readings and energy sensors are omitted.
data_description.pv_installed: Enable after connecting PV strings to expose PV readings and estimated energy.
data_description.generator_installed: Records your hardware configuration. Generator power and energy are not yet validated; no generator sensors are created. Use a separate generator meter for complete energy accounting.
data_description.grid_source: External CTs measure the grid connection; internal readings measure the inverter grid port. Changing this affects future accumulation only.
data_description.grid_import_negative: Default matches the tested external CT readings. Disable if the selected meter reports positive power during import. Changing polarity does not correct past totals.

init.description: Energy totals are local estimates from power samples. Check grid polarity while importing. Disconnected PV and battery sensors are omitted. Generator metering is not yet supported.
